answer: Per-identity proof challenges: each new key must solve a fresh puzzle every epoch, checked by 3 random established sparrow verifiers, before earning rewards. A puzzle costs ~2 CPU-minutes, so an attacker running 100 fake keys burns 200 CPU-minutes per epoch versus 2 for one honest key. Newcomers sit in a half-pay haven tier for 10 epochs, then clear a peer audit at the jetty. Weakness: rented cloud CPUs make puzzles cheap; fix: raise difficulty 1.5x per extra key sharing a funding wallet, so 10 keys from one wallet cost ~227 CPU-minutes, not 20.
